column1: # The skip ledger of the vendored Ajv's spec/extras (README.md): one line
# per test the import does not honour yet, read by
# file is the path under spec/extras/, construct is what the import says it
# lost, comma-joined, or the code it refused the schema with, and
# that carries it. A listed test the import honours fails the run, so
# a phase deletes the lines it clears and lowers the bound to match.
